title: Research: legal H6 compensation networks and cost screen (no new kappa)
body:
The H6 proposal gives a conditional helper budget but leaves compensation loading, frame chronology and dirty restoration open. This PR supplies a finite local word and its cost screen: complete compressed edge and address-bucket networks with legal `[1,15,1]` helper paths, arbitrary logical dirt restoration in both orientations, and an explicit 816-center K encoder. The bucket word uses **227,312,640 helpers**, exceeding the largest allowance among tested L3/5/7 profiles (**94,434 at L5**). No new kappa or supplier admission is claimed.

This continues the [H6 exchange in Discussion 1167](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18914564) and [DreamingOfClouds's pinned script publication](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18914905). It includes the independent budget/Walsh audit and its construction successor. The [finding and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18923267) are posted in the originating H6 thread. [PR1698](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1698) independently overlaps the arithmetic; this adds exhaustive structural evidence, explicit legal words, exact frame recipes, coefficient streams and actual profile pricing. All changes stay in the three H6 research directories; imported predecessors, PR606 inputs, upstream and the selected record are preserved.

**Evidence and replay:** readable summaries reference lossless compressed matrices, witnesses and fixtures by canonical decompressed JSON hashes, following `CONTRIBUTING.md`. All eight migrated payloads are unchanged from the originally submitted head. The package checks all 665,856 polynomial coefficients and 25,263,360 feature entries, finite all-column words, representative physical recipes, and exact rational invoices. Twelve optimized replay steps and the fresh-export mutation gate pass; hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/h6-compensation-network/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/h6-compensation-network/gate/replay.py
make selected-record-check
```

Use Python 3.12 with NumPy 2.3.5 and full Git history. Exact pins, receipts, credit and **Open next questions** are in [the report](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/289d1bc9a56df97ea0aa3d1502701117389b9264/research/h6-compensation-network/README.md) and [validation scope](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/289d1bc9a56df97ea0aa3d1502701117389b9264/research/h6-compensation-network/VALIDATION.md).

**Open:** the billion-event full word is not executed, and immutable bank/controller/pad/tape integration, approximate-child precision, all-size bit supply and analytic transfer remain unadmitted. The 60/27-bit grid bounds assume exact local children. Partial mask routes cannot compose with K for free; fixed-architecture exclusions do not lower-bound arbitrary mixed circuits.

Credit Dominik Scholz/PR606, DreamingOfClouds/H6/PR1590, Andrey Mas/PR1698 and the selected/pending lineage. Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and ten specialist agents. Apache-2.0; no independent human or full-theorem verification claim.
